svg.aria-label: A 2x2 grid of four identical stylized symbols on an 850x850 canvas. Symbol placements are aligned to a 50-unit grid. Each symbol features a central green circle surrounded by a green frame with rounded outer corners and concave rounded inner corners.
svg.title: 2x2 Grid of Stylized Green Symbols (850x850, Snapped)
svg.desc: Four identical green symbols arranged in a square grid on an 850x850 canvas. Symbol placement coordinates are rounded to the nearest 50. This results in approximately 90 units of padding around the grid, and a 30-unit gap between symbols. Each symbol has a central dot and a surrounding frame with rounded outer and inner corners. The fill color is #577B63.
